results.title: Murder Me
results.overview: A novice drag queen is given a golden opportunity to become a star, but she'll have to give up on herself to achieve it. Her decision must be made before the party’s over.

results.title: Calypso
results.overview: A nurse keeps a patient in a coma, but one day his wife and son visit him.

results.title: Randy
results.overview: Amidst an infection via auditory frequency, a band struggles to keep from falling apart.

results.title: Volchok
results.overview: Thirteen-year-old nobleman and orphan Vanya Ogarev flees from Moscow to Nizhny Novgorod, fleeing assassins sent by his own uncle, who decided to take possession of the boy's inheritance. To protect himself, Vanya hires a random fist fighter named Volchok.

results.title: Traumatika
results.overview: Mikey's night terrors become reality when his mother begins showing signs of demonic possession. What he's about to experience will haunt him for the rest of his life and claim countless lives across generations.

results.title: Gangland
results.overview: A weathered tribal cop and his new trainee must find a ruthless fugitive, whose return to their rural Indigenous reservation has exposed its darkest secrets and could ignite a violent gang war.

results.title: Girl in the Cellar
results.overview: A mother imprisons her daughter in their basement to prevent bad choices, unaware she's recreating her own traumatic past. As neighbors notice the girl's absence, suspicion falls on the conflicted mother.

results.title: Hitler's Cosmic Conspiracy: UFOs, Alien Artifacts and the Nazi War Machine
results.original_title: Hitler's Cosmic Conspiracy: UFOs, Alien Artifacts and the Nazi War Machine
results.overview: Explore the mysterious legend of the Thule society and the mystical "Vril" energy that the Nazi's claimed aided them in their pursuit for world power.

results.title: Improvements
results.overview: Alice learned from her Dad.  The first rule of renovation is to start small: Pick one room and move out from there. Make lists. Check them off. Begin again.

results.title: Phantosmia
results.overview: Daniel and Jorge are a couple who lead a calm life inside their small apartment. However, things will quickly change as strange events lead them to wonder if they are, really, the only ones living there or if an unexpected presence is reclaiming the space it believes to be its own.

results.title: Three Wolves
results.overview: A video file is found on a hard drive, containing footage of a man known as "Number 3". He is suspected of having a surgically inserted "death's head" coin in his body as he is monitored by security cameras to track physical and mental changes. The coin is rumored to be forged from WW II death's head rings, said to contain the souls of the soldiers that wore them. These coins were surgically inserted into "patients" to test the efficacy of the lore.

results.title: Dali
results.overview: A Bulgarian-born, American-raised rapper dies and faces The Gatekeeper at the crossroads of the afterlife, where he must relive his tumultuous past—family struggles, lost love, and a life of excess—to determine whether he belongs Above or Below.

results.title: A Danny Elfman Christmas Story
results.overview: Danny Elfman narrates a darkly whimsical Christmas tale.

results.title: The Moth
results.overview: A disheveled, humanoid Moth, drawn into a 24/7 optometrist office by the allure of its neon-light sign, regales the attending physician about his troubling life story and insatiable cravings that led to the demise of his family.

results.title: Juliette
results.overview: A confession of love at a poetry reading, inspired by true feelings of unrequited love the director experienced as a queer youth.

results.title: 15 Days
results.overview: Two best friends in the service industry need to seek means of income during the covid-19 lock downs.

results.title: Bottled Up
results.overview: Eleanor returns home where she reunites with her childhood best friend, Camilla, who have both been away at college on opposite coasts. This reunion floods Eleanor with the feelings she has for Camilla, such as her appreciation of their friendship, but also the romantic feelings she’s been attempting to keep bottled up. When a game of spin the bottle ends up with them kissing, she’s left even more lost.

results.title: Blue Eyed Girl
results.overview: Fortysomething Jane Messina is forced to re-evaluate her life after returning home to visit her two sisters and her sick father, making her wonder what could have been with her first love.

results.title: Tongue
results.overview: When a college student discovers her tongue can read minds through touch, she reluctantly teams up with her best friend to solve a mysterious death at a frat party—but as she licks her way through a parade of suspects, she uncovers a dark secret that could cost her more than just her sanity.

results.title: Upon Her Lips: French Kiss
results.overview: From the lush mountains of Corsica to windswept beaches where surfers thrive and the red light district of Paris where passers by flirt and follow, discover the exciting journeys and discoveries of French women and their cinema.
